name: amurites_horseman
description: an Amurite Horseman, a cavalryman in a steel morion helmet with a blue plume, dark hair, steel shoulder plates and mail, a blue tabard with a white cross over it and brown riding boots, a steel-tipped wooden lance in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side and a round blue shield with a white star and a steel rim on his RIGHT arm on the screen-left side, riding a dapple-grey horse with a dark grey mane and tail, a brown bridle and dark hooves
hands: the lance stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round blue shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
